title: Compliance Concierge: Guided Audit Response & Residency Snapshots
creator: Aisha Mendoza
description: Provide a guided, low-friction workflow that helps customers assemble and submit audit packages: 1) capture immutable "snapshots" that record data residency, retention settings, and configuration at a point in time; 2) synthesize DPA-relevant excerpts and mapped answers to common questionnaires; and 3) produce a downloadable audit bundle (PDF + CSV + config manifests) with provenance metadata and signed assertions. The Concierge is aimed at early enterprise customers who receive external compliance questionnaires and audits and need fast, auditable evidence without engineering lift.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can create a named residency snapshot that captures region, storage class, retention config, active KMS key IDs, and exportable object counts
Snapshots are immutable once created and are stamped with a cryptographic hash and timestamp
Admin user can run a guided questionnaire flow that auto-populates answers from snapshots and configurable policy templates
System can generate a ZIP audit bundle containing: snapshot manifest (JSON), a human-readable summary (PDF), redacted config exports (CSV/TSV), and a checklist mapping to common questionnaire items
Bundles include provenance headers (who created, when, linked ticket/PR) and are recorded in Console activity logs
End-to-end smoke tests cover snapshot creation, questionnaire mapping, bundle generation, and bundle download within SLOs
implementation_notes: Back-end API: new /snapshots endpoints (create/list/get/export) that pin effective configurations and metadata
Console UI: 'Start Audit Bundle' flow in Settings > Compliance that walks admins through selecting snapshot + questionnaire template
Storage: snapshot manifests are stored in immutable S3 objects with versioning; signed metadata stored in the control plane DB
Security: snapshot creation requires 'Compliance Admin' role; export endpoints audit-log every download; HSM/KMS used for signing assertions
Privacy: sensitive fields (PII, exact user lists) must be redacted by default; customers can include additional redacted artifacts via manual upload
Scale: export generation must stream to avoid large memory spikes for orgs with millions of objects; support pagination and sampling for object counts
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (Alpha): Internal-only preview with 3 pilot customers; manual support from SEs; gather edge-cases and questionnaire templates
Stage 2 (Beta): UI-enabled for all paid accounts; guided templates for SOC2, ISO, and common vendor questionnaires; telemetry enabled
Stage 3 (GA): Hardened performance, RBAC controls, audit-log retention policy options, and internationalization for EU/JP locales
Post-GA: Add automated DPA clause extractor and template mapping driven by NLP to reduce manual mapping time
metrics: Time-to-bundle (median): target < 90 seconds for orgs < 10k objects
Number of manual support escalations per bundle: target < 0.05
Pilot customer NPS on audit readiness: target +40
Adoption: % of enterprise customers who used at least one snapshot within 90 days
